en autostol.explanation: "En autostol" means "a car seat". It is built from "auto" (car) and "stol" (chair).

en avis.explanation: "En avis" means "a newspaper". To say you have a regular delivery that you pay for, use "abonnere på" (to subscribe to): "Vi abonnerer på en avis" (We subscribe to a newspaper).

en avocado.explanation: "En avocado" means "an avocado". To say it is ripe, use "moden" (ripe): "Avocadoen er moden" (The avocado is ripe).

et abonnement.explanation: "Et abonnement" means "a subscription". To say you start one, use "tegne" (to take out): "Jeg vil gerne tegne et abonnement" (I would like to take out a subscription).

et adgangskrav.explanation: "Et adgangskrav" means "an admission requirement". It is built from "adgang" (access) and "krav" (demand). To say you meet it, use "opfylde" (to fulfil): "Hun opfylder adgangskravet" (She meets the admission requirement).

et afslag.explanation: "Et afslag" means "a refusal". When you talk about a lower price, it means "a price reduction": "Vi fik et afslag i prisen" (We got a reduction in the price).

et afsnit.explanation: "Et afsnit" means "an episode". When you count what you watched, say: "Jeg har set tre afsnit" (I have watched three episodes). When you talk about a text, it means "a section": "Læs det første afsnit" (Read the first section).

et agern.explanation: "Et agern" means "an acorn". Do not mix it up with "et egern" (a squirrel). To say an acorn lies somewhere: "Der ligger et agern på jorden" (There is an acorn on the ground). To say a squirrel is somewhere: "Der sidder et egern i træet" (There is a squirrel in the tree).

et aktieselskab.explanation: "Et aktieselskab" means "a public limited company". It is built from "aktie" (share) and "selskab" (company). In a company name, the short form is "A/S": "Carlsberg A/S".

et akvarium.explanation: "Et akvarium" means "an aquarium". When you talk about a place you visit with many large tanks, it also means "an aquarium": "Vi så hajer i akvariet" (We saw sharks in the aquarium).

et alarmnummer.explanation: "Et alarmnummer" means "an emergency number". It is built from "alarm" (alarm) and "nummer" (number).

et album.explanation: "Et album" means "an album". To talk about photos, put "foto" (photo) in front: "et fotoalbum" (a photo album).

et alfabet.explanation: "Et alfabet" means "an alphabet". A fact about Denmark: the Danish alphabet has 29 letters. To say things are in alphabetical order, use "alfabetisk" (alphabetical): "Ordene står i alfabetisk rækkefølge" (The words are in alphabetical order).

et alibi.explanation: "Et alibi" means "an alibi". When you talk about an excuse, it also means "an excuse": "Hun brugte travlheden som alibi" (She used being busy as an excuse).

et alternativ.explanation: "Et alternativ" means "an alternative". To say there is no other choice, say: "Der er intet alternativ" (There is no alternative). When you describe something as different from the normal kind, it works as an adjective: "alternativ medicin" (alternative medicine).

et anførselstegn.explanation: "Et anførselstegn" means "a quotation mark". It is also called "gåseøjne" (literally, goose eyes). To say you put a word between quotation marks, say: "Skriv ordet i anførselstegn" (Write the word in quotation marks).

et angreb.explanation: "Et angreb" means "an attack". It comes from the verb "at angribe" (to attack). To say someone starts attacking, use "gå til angreb" (to go on the attack): "Soldaterne gik til angreb" (The soldiers went on the attack).

et anker.explanation: "Et anker" means "an anchor". To say a ship pulls up its anchor and leaves, use "lette anker" (to weigh anchor): "Skibet letter anker" (The ship weighs anchor).

et anlæg.explanation: "Et anlæg" means "a facility / plant". To name a specific kind of facility, put a word in front: "et idrætsanlæg" (a sports facility).

et anpartsselskab.explanation: "Et anpartsselskab" means "a private limited company". It is built from "anpart" (share) and "selskab" (company). In a company name, the short form is "ApS": "Café Sol ApS".

et ansigt.explanation: "Et ansigt" means "a face". To say people meet in person, use "ansigt til ansigt" (face to face): "Vi mødtes ansigt til ansigt" (We met face to face).

et ansigtstræk.explanation: "Et ansigtstræk" means "a facial feature". Do not mix it up with "et ansigtsudtryk" (a facial expression). To talk about a part of the face, use "ansigtstræk": "Hans næse er et tydeligt ansigtstræk" (His nose is a clear facial feature). To talk about the look on a face, use "ansigtsudtryk": "Hun fik et vredt ansigtsudtryk" (She got an angry facial expression).

et ansigtsudtryk.explanation: "Et ansigtsudtryk" means "a facial expression". To say what the expression is like, put a describing word in front: "et glad ansigtsudtryk" (a happy facial expression).

et ansvar.explanation: "Et ansvar" means "a responsibility". To say someone accepts it, use "tage" (to take): "Han tager ansvar for fejlen" (He takes responsibility for the mistake).

et antal.explanation: "Et antal" means "a number (amount)", as in how many. When you talk about how many guests came, say: "Antallet af gæster var lille" (The number of guests was small). Do not mix it up with "et tal" (a number). When you talk about the number 5 itself, use "et tal": "Fem er et tal" (Five is a number).
